title: Design a Workflow System
description_html:
Design a workflow system over tasks and dependencies. Support:

  • Add a task.
  • Add a dependency between tasks (task1 depends on task2).
  • Output the execution order of tasks (a valid topological order).
  • Deep copy the workflow.
  • Handle cyclic dependencies (report when no valid order exists).

Input

First line: integer T (number of operations). Each subsequent line:

  • 1 task_name — add a task (names are unique)
  • 2 task1 task2 — add dependency (task1 depends on task2)
  • 3 — output execution order
  • 4 — deep copy the workflow

Output

For each 3, the execution order (or a cycle indicator); for each 4, a deep-copy marker/identifier.

Example

6
1 A
1 B
2 B A      # B depends on A
3          -> A B
4          -> copy#1
3          -> A B

Composite design: topological order (Kahn) + cycle detection + graph deep copy (#133-style). See Notes.
